name: worcestershire sauce
ingredientsText: WATER, DISTILLED VINEGAR, MOLASSES, SALT, CITRIC ACID, DEXTROSE, CARAMEL COLOR, NATURAL FLAVORS, MALIC ACID, HYDROLYZED SOY AND CORN PROTEIN, ONION*, GARLIC*.
notes: 'HYDROLYZED SOY AND CORN PROTEIN' names soy, so soy is contains. No anchovies in this one.
